description: The Sewage Treatment Plant Operator is responsible for the operation, monitoring, and maintenance of sewage treatment plants. They ensure that wastewater is treated effectively and in compliance with environmental regulations. Sewage Treatment Plant Operators perform various tasks to control and maintain the treatment process, troubleshoot issues, and ensure the plants efficient and safe operation.
